title: SignedPayload with an empty payload encodes to a strkey the library's own parser refuses
severity_basis: Encode side only. stellar-xdr 28.0.0 and 28.0.1 pin stellar-strkey 0.0.13; stellar-strkey 0.0.17 (#107) requires a non-empty payload and stellar-xdr 30.0.0 pins stellar-strkey 1.0.0.

entries.expected: refuse to encode a signed payload of 0 bytes (SEP-23: 1 to 64 bytes)
entries.observed: Executed on 28.0.0 and 28.0.1, which pin stellar-strkey 0.0.13: SignedPayload with an empty payload encodes to PA7QYNF7…AAAAAAKH4Y, which the library's own parser refuses. stellar-strkey 0.0.17 (#107) requires a non-empty payload; stellar-xdr 30.0.0 pins stellar-strkey 1.0.0 and refuses.

evidence.pre_fix: Conformance runner (xcc conform run --set all), L4, on rust@28.0.0 and rust@28.0.1 (both profiles).
evidence.expected_basis: SEP-23 v1.4.0: a signed payload carries 1 to 64 bytes.

reproduction.method: Independent reviewer reproduction from the record alone on 2026-11-12: 4 of 4 listed report rows failed again as recorded, all offline. Review: findings/review/F-0029.json.

evidence_added.reason: Fixed upstream; the upstream item already carries the reproduction and the fix, so no new evidence is added.

history.note: Created from the known divergences that reference https://github.com/stellar/rs-stellar-strkey/pull/107 and their failure rows.
The upstream item already records this defect.
